request.style: English, orchestral, warm female solo voice with gentle choir backing, piano, strings, soft percussion, majestic and comforting mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
As smoke is driven away
The wicked perish in the fire
But let the righteous be glad
Exulting before Him higher

[Chorus]
A father to the fatherless
A defender of widows
God in his holy dwelling
Singing praises to his name

[Verse]
Lift up a song for the Lord
Who rides through the deserts
Rejoice before him always
His name is the Lord

[Chorus]
A father to the fatherless
A defender of widows
God in his holy dwelling
Singing praises to his name

[Bridge]
Settles the lonely in a home
Leads prisoners to prosperity
The rebellious dwell in scorched land
Earth shook and heavens poured rain

[Outro]
The One of Sinai
God of Israel
